# Contributing to OrvexaOS

Thanks for helping improve OrvexaOS.

## Before making changes

1. Search existing issues and pull requests to avoid duplicate work.
2. For larger changes, open an issue first to discuss the approach.
3. Keep changes focused and preserve existing features.

## Development

- Work on a separate branch and open a pull request into `main`.
- Follow the style used by nearby files.
- Keep app-specific code and assets in the relevant app folder.
- Do not commit credentials, access tokens, private data, or generated secrets.
- Update documentation and app registry entries when your change requires it.

## Testing

Test the affected screen and relevant behavior in a browser where possible. For JavaScript changes, check syntax and inspect the browser console. Include the tests performed and any limitations in your pull request.

## Pull requests

Explain what changed, why it is needed, how it was tested, and include screenshots for visual changes when useful. Complete the pull request checklist.
